mechanics.claim: The empowered feather fires on every basic attack hit during the buff, dealing extra on-hit damage as a separate missile.
mechanics.quote: causing her basic attacks to strike a second time, dealing '''reduced''' damage

mechanics.claim: The additional missile's damage benefits from crits on the triggering attack but cannot itself critically strike.
mechanics.quote: Since the additional missile's damage is based on a percentage of the triggering attack's damage, it will also benefit from the increased damage of triggering attacks that {{tip|critically strike}}.

mechanics.claim: The additional missile itself cannot critically strike.
mechanics.quote: The additional missile itself however cannot {{tip|critically strike}}.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack will not trigger against wards.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack will not trigger against [[ward]]s.

mechanics.claim: Deadly Plumage does not interact with Guinsoo's Rageblade Phantom Hit.
